## What's Changed

### New Features

- **Instant page switching**: pages now swap in place instead of reloading the whole document — 91 ms instead of 321 ms in benchmarks.
- **Command palette recents**: pages you've visited float to the top of the palette.
- **Logout in the `>` command list**.

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed select popups, date pickers, scrollbars and autofill coming out in the wrong mode.
- Fixed port status cards overlapping on devices with several ports (#78).
- Fixed the interfaces overview cards not lining up.
- Fixed the reboot page's button sitting flush against the description text.
- Fixed checkboxes sitting a few pixels above the text on their line.
- Fixed the log pages: "Scroll to head" landing behind the alert banner, uneven scroll-button spacing, and row highlighting cut off on scrolled lines (#60).
- Fixed oversized 32 px interface icons on the overview and in badge tooltips.

### Other Changes

- For remaining changes, see the [full changelog](https://github.com/eamonxg/luci-theme-aurora/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0)
